mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OUTPUT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.out.deleteOut */ WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.out.selectOut */ o.ID as id, o.PJT_ID as pjtId, o.NAME as name, o.CREATED_AT as createdAt, o.UPDATED_AT as updatedAt, o.APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, o.APPROVAL_DATE as approvalDate, o.APPROVAL_COMMENT as approvalComment, o.OUTPUT_TYPE as outputType, o.IS_DELETED as isDeleted, pjt.PJT_NAME as pjtName FROM OUTPUT o LEFT JOIN PJT pjt ON o.PJT_ID = pjt.PJT_ID WHERE o.ID = #{id}
